title: test(e2e/live): the eleven stale live specs, each brought back to the shipped showcase or retired (objectui#13104)
body:
Fixes #13104

Clause-②: no

Every row has its conclusion: the card's eleven, plus `studio-editor`, which the claim's amendment (comment `6283451551`) added as row 12. Eleven specs are repaired against the current surface and the shipped showcase. One case is deliberately retired (`user-filters`' lookup quick filter). `screen-flow` needs no change because its red does not reproduce. ⛔ No product source is touched; the diff is eleven files under `e2e/live/`. No `test.skip` / `test.fixme` is added, and `record-history-display`'s skip guard is gone.

This is a resume dispatch. The first dev's draft (`2f09525`) was unverified when its container restarted. Every row below was re-measured, red on BASE `df943a2` and green on this head. Three commits on top of the draft change what did not hold (R1, R4, R5 below). Patch round 1 adds `8493767` for row 12. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_014MXhk1yjWh37d634hLy3p7`.

## How it was measured

- **Backend (the one the card names, "the shipped showcase"):** objectstack `main` `d20bf9b09`, whose `.objectui-sha` is the shipped console pin `12dc7b47c340`. Its `examples/app-showcase` ran from a built objectstack worktree with `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4113`, on a fresh database for each whole-suite run.
- **Console:** this worktree's console Vite dev server (`cd apps/console && DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4113 pnpm exec vite --port 5213 --strictPort`). The diff touches only `e2e/live/`, so the console source under test is BASE's.
- **Runner:** `pnpm exec playwright test` with `playwright.live.config.ts` wrapped only to add `executablePath: /opt/pw-browsers/chromium`. This container's Playwright 1.62.1 wants chromium revision 1234, and 1194 is the one installed. The BASE specs ran from a `git archive df943a2 e2e/live` copy.
- **Whole-suite runs:** every spec under `e2e/live/`, in one run, alphabetical, one worker, as the Tier 1 run (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24598) ran them.
  - BASE: 46 passed, 15 failed or timed out, 1 skipped.
  - Head `3afb8d1` (round 1): 59 passed, 2 failed, both `studio-editor`.
  - Head `8493767` (patch round 1, row 12 repaired): 61 passed (11.0m), exit 0. Every spec is green, `studio-editor` included.
- **Control backend (H2):** objectui's own CI-lane backend: `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.5` plus the showcase at its release tag (`820fd5ae`), on `:4114`, with a second console dev server on `:5214`. The head `3afb8d1` whole-suite run there gave the same reading as the primary: 59 passed, 2 failed, both `studio-editor`. In patch round 1 the repaired `studio-editor` also ran there at `8493767`: 2 passed. `backend.env` is not edited.

## Per-row conclusions

Before = BASE `df943a2`, after = the final head, both read from the whole-suite runs above (tests passed / tests in the spec).

| spec | cause, re-measured at BASE | conclusion | before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `studio-object-designer` | F1 timed out: it opens the Studio app, which a stock boot does not serve. F4: the banner is "A `select` field needs its choices", for a picklist with no option source | repaired: F1 on the Studio surface's package switcher (R4); F4 gives the picklist one option before adding the empty row | 2/4 → 4/4 |
| `studio-record-page` | `getByLabel(/^Object/i)` resolves first to the app bar's "ObjectOS home" link, and the Object control is a `role=combobox`; Page type now defaults to list | repaired: anchored label, combobox and option, Page type set to record | 0/1 → 1/1 |
| `user-filters` | tabs: no `view-tab-urgent` (ADR-0053 made tabs an interface-page element); switcher: not in the toolbar; hollow view: `cell` where the grid exposes `gridcell`; lookup filter: no filter bar on `showcase_task.tabular` | repaired: tabs on the Task Triage page, the switcher through the Display popover with the exact shipped whitelist, `gridcell`. The lookup case is retired (R2) | 2/6 → 5/5 |
| `inline-edit-polish-2572` | the lock poll read 8 edit affordances where 0 were expected: the request opens on `manager_review` (`lockRecord: false`); the spec also spent the seeded project | repaired: its own project, and the lock asserted at `exec_review` (R1) | 0/1 → 1/1 |
| `field-conditional-rules` | no `tax_rate` input where `toBeDisabled` waited: a `readonlyWhen` field renders the read-only field group | repaired: the input is gone and the read-only group is shown under `paid`, and back to an editable input under `sent` / `draft` | 0/1 → 1/1 |
| `grid-file-upload` | `getByText('Line Items')` matches the sr-only DialogDescription and the section heading (strict mode). The second cause (ADR-0104 stored form) sits behind it | repaired: the section found by its heading role; the receipt is a file id, read back byte for byte through `GET /api/v1/storage/files/ID` | 0/1 → 1/1 |
| `form-view-subforms` | the same `Line Items` collision | repaired: heading role | 0/1 → 1/1 |
| `cascading-options` | no `md-form-submit` on `showcase_cascade`'s flat ModalForm | repaired: waits for the ModalForm's `modal-form-footer` | 1/2 → 2/2 |
| `detail-related-list` | `waitForURL(/[?&]recordId=/)` timed out: a row's name link opens `/record/ID` | repaired: the id read from the route, on Northwind; the primary Projects list in its own tab (R3) | 0/1 → 1/1 |
| `record-history-display` | skipped by its app-todo guard | repaired: targets `showcase_account`, with no skip guard (R5) | skipped → 1/1 |
| `screen-flow` | passes at BASE, both alone and in the whole-suite order | no change: the card's red does not reproduce (below) | 1/1 → 1/1 |
| `studio-editor` (row 12) | the shipped `showcase_project_workspace` opens read-only (lock `no-overlay`), so there is no "Add block"; and the page form has no "Layout" section heading. Both are intended (below) | repaired: each test authors an editable copy of the page; the Layout check reads where the layout renders, on the canvas | 0/2 → 2/2 |

**`screen-flow` (read first, as triage asked).** No record names a cause for the Tier 1 red. objectstack-ai/objectstack#24598 says only "FAILED (known-stale, not consulted)". On the shipped showcase it passes at BASE alone and in the whole-suite order. objectui's own Live E2E lane (published `18.0.0-next.5`) also reads it green, judged by the step `Run live E2E allowlist` = success with no `continue-on-error`:
- `main`'s scheduled run `39213623070`, at `4484a11`. That is three commits after the Tier 1 console pin `4016370a`, and the three touch record-page reads and publish tooling.
- PR run `39359398003`, today.

The job log itself answered 403 through this container's proxy, so the reading rests on the step conclusion.

## Review points

**R1 · `inline-edit-polish-2572`: the lock assertion is kept.**
- The draft swapped the lock for an "In approval · editable" reading. The lock is back, at a step that locks.
- Before (BASE): poll until `page.locator('[title="Double-click to edit"]').count()` is `0` after the request opens. Then `lockedBudgetGroup.dblclick()` and `expect(saveBtn).toBeHidden()`.
- Now:
  - (2a, an addition) at `manager_review`: "In approval · editable" is shown, and a double-click opens a session.
  - (2b) The test approves `manager_review` with `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID/approve`. The seeded admin holds the `manager` position (`ADMIN_APPROVAL_POSITIONS` in the showcase's `seed-approval-demo.ts`). It waits for the pending `exec_review` request with `lock_record: true`.
  - Then it asserts the original lock unchanged: zero affordances after a fresh mount, and a double-click that opens nothing. It adds the "Locked for approval" band as a positive signal.
- The budget edit moves from 160000 to 600000, because `exec_review` is reached only over the flow's decision edge for a budget above 500000 (`showcase_budget_approval` in the showcase's `automation/flows/index.ts`).
- Measured: BASE red (8 vs 0); `46625db` green alone (24.3 s); green in the head whole-suite run.

**R2 · `user-filters`' lookup quick filter: retired, with the measurement.**
- `git grep -n userFilters d20bf9b09 -- examples/app-showcase/src` lists every declaration in the shipped showcase (positive control: `allowedVisualizations` is found in `task.view.ts`).
- The views and pages read:
  - page `showcase_active_projects` (`health`, `status`);
  - page `showcase_task_triage` (tabs);
  - page `showcase_task_workbench` (`status`, `priority`);
  - `project.view.ts` (`status`, `health`).
- `task.view.ts` declares none by design; its own ADR-0053 note says so.
- Every one of those fields is `Field.select`. The task object's one lookup, `project` (master-detail), is a user filter nowhere. So no shipped fixture can drive the case, and it is deleted.
- Unit reading (not a diff): four plugin-list tests render the lookup filter picker (`filter-lookup-FIELD`):
  - `UserFilters.declaredDisplayField-10545`
  - `UserFilters.lateTypeCoercion-12008`
  - `UserFilters.pendingLabel-12890`
  - `UserFilters.retiredFieldType`
- 10545 pins the picker's display-field read. None of the four picks a record through the picker: the selection is seeded with `initialSelections`, and 12008's emitted-filter assertions are on boolean and numeric fields.
- **Coverage lost:** picking a record in a lookup quick filter narrows the list, persists as a `uf_FIELD` URL param and badges the count. Nothing pins that end to end now.

**R3 · `detail-related-list`: Northwind and its related list are in the shipped seed.**
- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/seed/index.ts` seeds the account `Northwind` and its projects "Website Relaunch" (active) and "Legacy Sunset" (completed).
- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/project.object.ts` declares the `account` lookup with `relatedList: 'primary'` and `relatedListTitle: 'Projects'`.
- "Rule Z" is objectui's own default in `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`: an `isPrimary` related list gets its own tab. It is pinned by the plugin-detail test "promotes an isPrimary related list to its OWN tab (rule Z default)".

**R4 · `studio-object-designer` F1: the title's promise holds, and the mechanism coverage is narrower.**
- Before (BASE): create the package on the Studio app's `developer/packages` page, then `getByTestId('package-switcher').click()` and `expect(getByRole('option', { name: pkgName })).toBeVisible()`.
- After: on `/studio/com.example.showcase/data`, create the package through the switcher's "New package" dialog, with no reload. Then:
  - `expect(chip).toContainText(pkgName)`;
  - the open switcher lists a button named by the package's name followed by its id. This commit tightened the draft's id-only match to the name the refreshed list carries.
- Why it moved: the sidebar `package-switcher` (`ContextSelectors.tsx`) renders only for an app that declares `contextSelectors`. A stock showcase boot serves `showcase_app`, `setup` and `account` (`GET /api/v1/meta/app`), and none declares one.
- What it no longer pins: the original watched a switcher that stays mounted while a package is created elsewhere, so it pinned the `objectui:packages-changed` refetch. On the Studio surface the create dialog navigates into the new package, and the switcher's list effect is keyed on the package id, so the route change alone refetches the list.
  - No unit test pins either switcher's `objectui:packages-changed` refetch. The only test that names the event is `packages-io.inflightShare-11797`, and it pins the in-flight read drop.
  - The draft cited ADR-0048 for "no stock boot loads the Studio app". objectstack's ADR-0048 is about cross-package metadata collision, so both comments now state the reading and its instrument instead.
- F4's BASE banner was the "needs its choices" error, not the "System identifier must be" error F4 guards. Giving the picklist an option first keeps F4 on its own bug.

**R5 · `record-history-display`: `showcase_account` declares `enable: { trackHistory: true }`** in `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/account.object.ts`.
- It is the only showcase object that does.
- Its fields, with the extension's, carry no boolean and no datetime. So the original's booleans-as-words and datetime legs cannot be driven on the showcase. Both stay pinned in app-shell's `auditHistoryDisplay.test.ts` ("localizes booleans through t with Yes/No fallback", "localizes datetime values instead of raw ISO strings"), and the spec header now says so.
- This head also asserts the "Customer Since" diff line before asserting no raw `YYYY-MM-DD`, so that check cannot pass on an absent line. Read once: "Customer Since: 7/26/2026 → 8/4/2026".

## H4

`grid-file-upload` and `form-view-subforms` share the `Line Items` cause. Each spec now finds the section by its heading role. `e2e/live/helpers.ts` is unchanged, so no other spec's reading moves.

## Row 12 · `studio-editor` (patch round 1)

**Correction first.** Round 1 said "Tier 1 read it green at `4016370a`", and that was wrong: it was inferred, not measured. Tier 1 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24598) never ran this spec. For `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip`, its pin set is "files 0/1 … (studio-record-page.spec.ts …)", and `studio-editor` appears nowhere in that record. Nothing moved between Tier 1 and now. objectstack-ai/objectstack#7753 item 6 (closed 2026-08-11) had already recorded both causes against QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7695: "targets a 'Layout' heading that no longer exists, plus a **shipped** page the editor correctly locks". objectstack's checklist carries the same record as `automated.stale` on that item.

**The producers, and whether each state is intended.** Both states are intended.
- **The lock.** `page` is registered create-only: `supportsOverlay: true, allowEnvironmentOverlay: false, allowRuntimeCreate: true` (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts`). ADR-0005's override table lists `page` as ❌ ("Conservative default — these bind to routes and side-effects"). Its addendum "Two-tier authorization (PR-10d.7, 2026-05)" says "users may author brand-new items of this type, but artifact-shipped items remain immutable".
  - objectui's `ResourceEditPage` applies that rule in its own two-tier gate ("artifact-backed items need allowEnvironmentOverlay").
  - Since objectstack-ai/objectstack#21670 (closed 2026-10-04), the layered read's protection envelope reports the same refusal: `servedLockState` joins `packagedBaseRefusal`. Read on the shipped showcase: `lock: no-overlay`, `editable: false`, `provenance: package`. That envelope is what draws the "This item is locked" banner.
  - The exact commit that introduced the console gate is NOT MEASURED. Both clones here are shallow (objectui from 2026-10-13, objectstack from 2026-09-16), and the commit-search endpoint answered 403 here, its control query included. The ADR names the rule, and objectstack-ai/objectstack#7753 dates the state to 2026-08-11 or earlier.
- **The missing "Layout" heading.** objectui `29bc4bf00f` (objectui#2308, 2026-07-06) prunes `name` / `regions` / `children` from the page form (`PAGE_FIELDS_OWNED_ELSEWHERE`, `page-schema.ts`): the block tree is "edited on the canvas", and no bare section header is left behind. The spec form's "Layout" section holds only `regions`, so it does not render.

**The repair keeps every assertion and re-points the two stale ones.**
- Each test authors an editable copy of the shipped page in the environment: GET `showcase_project_workspace`, PUT it under `e2e_studio_editor_STAMP`, and DELETE it in `finally`. The copy reads `lock: none`, `editable: true`, and after a run the page list holds no `e2e_` leftovers.
- "Config sections": the Basics heading, as before, plus the Data Context heading, plus a guard that no lock banner stands in front of the editor. The guard is a precondition, not a replacement.
- "Layout": read where the layout renders now, on the canvas. There is one Add block per region (the count is derived from the copied page's `regions`), and the canvas offers Add region. On the shipped page none of these render.
- Add block, and the picker's Card / Section / Record details, are unchanged. Each match is unique among the picker's 33 entries.
- Measured: BASE 0/2 (no "Layout" heading; no Add block, timeout); `8493767` 2/2 alone, and green in the final whole-suite run.

## Gates (head `8493767`, exit codes captured before any pipe)

- `pnpm type-check:e2e`: 0
- `pnpm exec eslint` over the eleven changed specs: 0 errors, 11 warnings (BASE bytes of the same files: 12)
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 (0 new citations)
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: 0
- `pnpm check:test-path-roots`: 0
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 0. No source or published contract of a released package changed, so no changeset is owed.
- The live suite table above is the acceptance reading.

## Acceptance notes

- The objectstack checklist's `automated.stale` markers for these specs are the objectstack `domain:devx` seat's to drop. ⛔ They are not edited here.
- Coverage this PR does not restore, named once more:
  - the lookup quick-filter pick (R2);
  - the mounted-switcher `objectui:packages-changed` refetch (R4);
  - booleans and datetimes in History on the live stack (R5, unit-pinned).
- Diff: 11 files, 353 insertions, 212 deletions.
